scenarios.title: Mars: A Light That Answers

finalObjectives.text: Bring the ascent capsule to the orbiter hatch with the returned specimens.

scenarios.ending: We’re through the orbiter’s hatch together, with our specimens and the picture from our table. The light that answered us has become our way home.
scenarios.limits: Author-aware structural replay only. Not source-blind playtesting, browser/UI verification, historical or scientific re-verification, or evidence of fun.

scenarios.ending: Observatory keeper: “Our atlas now holds the harvest promise beside the cost of losing darkness. We can propose a trial, but switching off the mirror will not erase its effects—or settle who owns the night.”
